title: Code Annotations (brand background, theme without background)
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    syntax-highlighting: pygments
    code-annotations: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'let bgcolor = rgb\("#ffeecc"\)'
        -
          - 'text\(fill: rgb\("#ffeecc"\), \[ #lnum'
